snippet.title: CALX Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
True Colors gave us a closer look at gameplay from the studio's atmospheric puzzle adventure CALX during this year's Spring Showcase. It's coming to PC on June 4 and consoles later this year, but you can play the demo now on Steam. 

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2022640/CALX/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
